description: Text card on black for the Never Ending Interview (16:9): the format explainer – title in capitals with RGB split and up to three short sentences, centred – or the transition sentence ("Our starting question comes from none other than…"). Glitch-in 0.3 s, glitch-out 0.2 s, 3–6 s, opaque H.264.

parameters.title: Title (drawn in capitals), up to 32 characters; optional
parameters.text: One sentence or a list of up to 3 sentences, at most 5 lines of 52 characters together
